name: INTJ
aka_description: Thought constitutes the greatness of man. Man is a reed, the feeblest thing in nature, but he is a thinking reed.
information: Architects are imaginative and strategic thinkers, with a plan for everything. These thoughtful tacticians love perfecting the details of life, applying creativity and rationality to everything they do. Their inner world is often a private, complex one.

name: INTP
aka_description: The important thing is not to stop questioning. Curiosity has its own reason for existence.
information: Logicians are innovative inventors with an unquenchable thirst for knowledge. These flexible thinkers enjoy taking an unconventional approach to many aspects of life. They often seek out unlikely paths, mixing willingness to experiment with personal creativity.

name: ENTJ
aka_description: Your time is limited, so don’t waste it living someone else’s life.
information: Commanders are bold, imaginative, and strong,willed, always finding a way – or making one. They are decisive people who love momentum and accomplishment. They gather information to construct their creative visions but rarely hesitate for long before acting on them.

name: ENTP
aka_description: Follow the path of the unsafe, independent thinker. Expose your ideas to the dangers of controversy.
information: Debaters are curious and flexible thinkers who cannot resist an intellectual challenge. They tend to be bold and creative, deconstructing and rebuilding ideas with great mental agility. They pursue their goals vigorously despite any resistance they might encounter.
weakness: Can Find It Difficult to Focus

name: INFJ
aka_description: Treat people as if they were what they ought to be and you help them to become what they are capable of being.
information: Advocates are quiet visionaries, often serving as inspiring and tireless idealists. They tend to approach life with deep thoughtfulness and imagination. Their inner vision, personal values, and a quiet, principled version of humanism guide them in all things.

name: INFP
aka: The Mediator, the Idealist or the Healer
aka_description: All that is gold does not glitter; not all those who wander are lost; the old that is strong does not wither; deep roots are not reached by the frost.
information: Mediators are poetic, kind, and altruistic people, always eager to help a good cause. These rare personality types tend to be quiet, open,minded, and imaginative, and they apply a caring and creative approach to everything they do.

name: ENFJ
aka: The Protagonist, the Giver or the Teacher
aka_description: When the whole world is silent, even one voice becomes powerful.
information: Protagonists are inspiring optimists, readily taking action to do what they feel is right. These warm, forthright types love helping others, and they tend to have strong ideas and values. They back their perspective with the creative energy to achieve their goals.

name: ENFP
aka: The Advocate, the Champion, or the Inspirer
aka_description: It doesn’t interest me what you do for a living. I want to know what you ache for – and if you dare to dream of meeting your heart’s longing.
information: Campaigners are enthusiastic, creative, and sociable free spirits, who can always find a reason to smile. These people tend to embrace big ideas and actions that reflect their sense of hope and goodwill toward others. Their vibrant energy can flow in many directions.

name: ISTJ
aka_description: I’d be more frightened by not using whatever abilities I’d been given. I’d be more frightened by procrastination and laziness.
information: Logisticians are practical and fact,minded individuals, whose reliability cannot be doubted. These people tend to be reserved yet willful, with a rational outlook on life. They compose their actions carefully and carry them out with methodical purpose.

name: ISFJ
aka_description: Love only grows by sharing. You can only have more for yourself by giving it away to others.
information: Defenders are very dedicated and warm protectors, always ready to defend their loved ones. These people tend to be warm and unassuming in their own steady way. They’re efficient and responsible, giving careful attention to practical details in their daily lives.

name: ESTJ
aka_description: Good order is the foundation of all things.
information: Executives are excellent organizers, unsurpassed at managing things – or people. They possess great fortitude, emphatically following their own sensible judgment. They often serve as a stabilizing force among others, able to offer solid direction amid adversity.

name: ESFJ
aka_description: Encourage, lift, and strengthen one another. For the positive energy spread to one will be felt by us all.
information: Consuls are very caring, social, community,minded people who are always eager to help. They are attentive and people,focused, and they enjoy taking part in their social community. Their achievements are guided by decisive values, and they willingly offer guidance to others.

name: ISTP
aka_description: I wanted to live the life, a different life. I didn’t want to go to the same place every day and see the same people and do the same job. I wanted interesting challenges.
information: Virtuosos are innovative and practical experimenters, masters of all kinds of tools. They tend to have an individualistic mindset, pursuing goals without needing much external connection. They engage in life with inquisitiveness and personal skill, varying their approach as needed.

name: ISFP
aka_description: I change during the course of a day. I wake and I’m one person, and when I go to sleep I know for certain I’m somebody else.
information: Adventurers are flexible and charming, always ready to explore and experience something new. They tend to have open minds, approaching life, new experiences, and people with grounded warmth. Their ability to stay in the moment helps them uncover exciting potentials.

name: ESTP
aka_description: Life is either a daring adventure or nothing at all.
information: Entrepreneurs are savvy, energetic, and very perceptive people who truly enjoy living on the edge. They tend to be energetic and action,oriented, deftly navigating whatever is in front of them. They love uncovering life’s opportunities, whether socializing with others or in more personal pursuits.

name: ESFP
aka_description: Live for each second without hesitation.
information: Entertainers are spontaneous, energetic, and enthusiastic people – life is never boring around them. These people love vibrant experiences, engaging in life eagerly and taking pleasure in discovering the unknown. They can be very social, often encouraging others into shared activities.
